# Third-party code

Third-party code bundled so that nothing beyond NumPy, SciPy and PyTorch has to be installed on the cluster.

* `pystoi/`: pystoi 0.4.1 (https://github.com/mpariente/pystoi), MIT licence (see `pystoi/LICENSE`),
  copied unchanged. Used by the Phase 3 evaluation suite for STOI and ESTOI. Requires numpy and scipy only.
